key_fields.meaning: 8-byte identifier at the start of the 80-byte record; the same picture as the user id in CSUSR01Y (Inferred from matching PIC only).
key_fields.name: UNUSED-ID

key_fields.meaning: 8-byte password-like field (name only; no program reads it).
key_fields.name: UNUSED-PWD

key_fields.meaning: 1-byte type code (name only; no program reads it).
key_fields.name: UNUSED-TYPE

observations.text: No COPY or EXEC SQL INCLUDE of UNUSED1Y exists in any inventoried program or copybook (docs/_work/structure/copybook-usage.json). Its 8+20+20+8+1+23 = 80-byte shape matches the user-security layout in CSUSR01Y; whether it is a retired copy of that layout needs SME confirmation.

purpose: Defines group UNUSED-DATA, an 80-byte record of six alphanumeric fields: id, first name, last name, password, type and filler. No program in the repository copies it, so it has no runtime role in this code base. The field shape mirrors a user record, but that is an observation from pictures and names, not from any usage.
